scope: decision register round 1: log hygiene, redaction parity, audit digest v2, archive verification, serialised writes

A5_log_hygiene.pairing: SyncPanel no longer logs the pairing payload or the SAS
A5_log_hygiene.screen_text: VisionAgentManager no longer logs node text; it logs only node counts
A5_log_hygiene.diagnostics: crash export uses a sanitizer (exception type only, absolute paths removed) and the note now says 'best effort' instead of promising no content

accessibility_secrets.change: password nodes are masked (is_password, text/content_description null) before leaving the service
accessibility_secrets.screenshot: takeScreenshot is API 30+ only; the platform already refuses FLAG_SECURE windows

redaction_parity.change: pure RedactionRules extracted from ContextRedactor; Rust rule widened to the same keys (password/passwd/token/secret/密码/口令, AKIA, JWT)
redaction_parity.tests: Java host test (test_redaction_parity.py) + Rust unit tests share the same corpus cases

audit_digest.change: schema 14 adds digest_version; new rows use length-prefixed v2, old rows keep v1 so existing chains and anchors stay valid
audit_digest.why: v1 joins fields with '|', so (taskId='x|1000', occurredAt=2000) and (taskId='x', occurredAt=1000, event='2000|e') hash the same string

archive_verification.change: export writes audit rows in rowid (chain) order with per-row prevHash/hash/digestVersion; import verifies link by link, checks auditCount and the declared head; archives without a head are imported but marked unverified
archive_verification.root_cause_fixed: export used ORDER BY occurred_at while the head came from ORDER BY rowid, so archives could fail their own verification after a clock skew
archive_verification.compat: pre-schema-14 archives keep working; audit subjects that are not UUIDs (system rows) are accepted with a safe-character check

items.serialised_writes: appendAudit/appendImportedAudit take a process-wide lock so two AgentStore instances cannot read the same tail and fork the chain

device_evidence.migration: schema 13 -> 14 on the Pixel 6a; audit page reports 10 events chain intact, 10 heads anchored
device_evidence.archive_round_trip: exported agent-os-memory-20261107.taos, imported it back: review passed per-row verification and reported '档案已导入'
device_evidence.logs: grep of logcat for the old pairing/SAS and node-text lines returns 0
